body: Any objections to this? The result would be broken builds if/when `@Injectable` or an `import` is omitted for a type which appears in the `directives` parameter of a `View` or `Component`.
I love errors and fully endorse your promotion.

issue.title: "EXCEPTION: Cannot find reflection information on FooBar" error is confusing
issue.body:
There are a number of causes, the exception should point to the root cause. e.g.:

a) FooBar is not annotated with @Injectable correctly
b) the transformer did not find FooBar
c) ...

In all cases, these errors should be detected at transform time instead of runtime.
